messages:
Maya: Quick watercooler question — you get to permanently leave exactly ONE non-work thing at your desk. What is it? One-line answers, and no plants (we already have a greenhouse). :thinking_face:
Derek: My late-night ramen bowl (ceramic with a chip). Always reminds me of grad school. :ramen:
Finn: Electric blanket. Cold office = zero will to do anything. :blanket: :cold_face:
Zoe: A tiny record player + one record. For mood-setting during deep work. :musical_note:
Lily: My sketchbook. If Im stuck I doodle my way out. :pencil2:
kudos-bot: Poll created — react with :one: ramen, :two: blanket, :three: record player, :four: sketchbook, :five: other
Maya: Other? say one word. Mine: "mug" (that never betrays your coffee). :coffee:
Derek: Vote :one: sentimental and microwave-safe.
Finn: Vote :two: pragmatic and warm.
Zoe: Vote :three: aesthetic wins. Also Id bring vinyl sleeves for everyone.
Lily: Vote :four: creativity preservation. Also sometimes used as a coaster. :wink:
Derek: If "other": :bear: childhood teddy (one-word: nostalgic)
Finn: If "other": :socks: lucky-socks (one-word: cozy)
Maya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/office-cozy-3o6ZtaO9BZHcOjmErm — "desk vibes"
Zoe: Bonus rule: you must name the item. Mines "Blue Moon" (the record player).
Lily: My sketchbook is "Doodle Bot". Very unoriginal but accurate.
Maya: Poll closes EOD. Winner gets brag rights + a tiny emoji trophy in the channel. Thanks for the soft items. :trophy:
